evidence.name: Screen field: Subscription plans
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Subscription plans" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Subscription plans
sections.description: The list of plans the user can buy. Each plan must be linked to a real product in your connected Stripe account, or checkout will fail when you publish. Per plan you set its four corner labels (top-left = plan name, bottom-left = description, top-right = price, bottom-right = billing period) and an optional badge. Mark your best-value plan as selected by default, since the pre-selected plan converts most often. Use 'Add Plan' to add rows.
